reuse.why: Extends the existing isScheduleExcludedDay predicate and routes getDatesInRange, which had inlined its own weekend/holiday check, through it.

duplication.why: Removes the one inline copy of the holiday check; the MM-DD matching exists only in the shared predicate.

placement.why: Holiday matching stays in shared/schedules.ts, where getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange get it.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the one call site that bypassed it, and tests.

maintainability.why: Every holiday decision now goes through one small function, so future holiday formats change in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: After the change every holiday check goes through isScheduleExcludedDay; the diff removes the inline check in getDatesInRange.
